items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button with variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link), sizes, asChild, and a loading state that disables it and sets aria-busy.

items.name: use-debounce
items.title: useDebounce
items.description: React hook that returns a value only after it has stopped changing for a delay in ms (default 300). Use for search inputs and expensive effects.

items.name: login-01
items.title: Login 01
items.description: Email and password sign-in card with labeled fields, autocomplete hints and a loading submit button. Installs a /login page and a LoginForm component with an onSubmit prop.

items.name: designduck-theme
items.title: Designduck Theme
items.description: Minimal neutral color tokens with a single blue accent for light and dark mode, plus a 0.5rem radius. Install to re-skin any shadcn components via CSS variables.
